about: The golden set for `python run.py --eval`. Claims under `present` must still be in library/claims. Sentences under `absent` must never be quoted by any claim: one is an internal case comment the customer never saw, the other was spoken by the Momentive side of a call. Pairs under `together` were said by different accounts about one failure and must sit in one theme, and no two theme titles may say the same thing: that is the editor's side of the drift. Every claim in the library is also checked to make sure its locator still resolves to a real turn or comment under data/. The nightly job runs this after the pipeline and fails loudly when the library drifts.

present.quote: Every renewal statement we send out is missing the balance that carried over from the previous period, so the invoice total reads far higher than it should.
Any report we try to export once membership crosses about ten thousand rows just cuts off partway through instead of finishing the file.
The general ledger sync has posted the same journal entry twice on more than one closing, and our bookkeeper has to go back and reverse the duplicate by hand.
A posting expires and comes down with no warning to the person who placed it, so postings vanish while they still think it is live.
We need to upload SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 packages straight into the learning module without rebuilding every course by hand.
Our year end donor report stops at about 3,200 rows even though we have close to 5,000 donors on file.

together.why: identity provider role changes, two accounts
quotes: When someone changes roles in our identity provider the sync misses it, and they keep the old permission set until someone catches it manually.
Staff who move departments still show up with their prior access weeks later because the provisioning sync does not pick up the role change.

together.why: renewal totals ignoring what was already paid, two accounts
quotes: Every renewal statement we send out is missing the balance that carried over from the previous period, so the invoice total reads far higher than it should.
When one of our chapters upgrades partway through the year we get billed the full renewal amount again in the fall, with nothing knocked off for what was already collected.

together.why: check-in through a wifi outage, two accounts
quotes: Our onsite team needs event check-in to keep working even when the venue wifi drops, and then sync everything back once we are online again.
The attendee kiosk has to keep taking people in even if the venue connection goes down, and catch back up automatically the moment it reconnects.
